SY215
Sociology of Health and Illness
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
examines the concepts of health and illness not as simple facts but as experiences and states of being that can be mobilized in the service of institutions, public policy, human resource exploitation and management, and as both/either personal troubles and public problems.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Senior Student
Exclusions
HS200
, SY322, SY323*.
